svg.title: A dopamine synapse: vesicles in the pre-synaptic dopamine neuron release dopamine into the synapse toward dopamine receptors on the post-synaptic neuron. Adderall, a dopamine release agonist, makes the neuron release more dopamine; Ritalin, a dopamine reuptake antagonist, blocks the reuptake transporter, so dopamine stays in the synapse.
